metadata.title: Clicked like I owed them a soda and somehow landed the 1 clueless kill?! Valorant logic is wild
metadata.description:
Clicked like my brain was buffering.
Enemy probably uninstalling in disbelief.
Pretending that was skill for 0.13 seconds.
Click if your aim’s a hot mess but kills still happen!

Tap if your aim’s a complete mystery but the game still gives you a kill!
